about: Frozen given names. A pin outranks the draw, so a name here can never move again — not when the syllable bands change, not when a species is added, not when the roster reorders. Joe, 2 Aug 2026, after the unseeded generator handed a six-year-old a rabbit called Defuck: "no dont change the generator, we hard fix the first 24 animals instead". Every DEPLOYED collection is pinned here — base, garden and home-pets — because a name a child can already be dealt is a name that must not drift. Two are Joe overrules rather than the drawn name: animal-lovebird was Vagod and animal-budgie was Pewod, both of which read badly out loud, and he chose Vapod and Plewod on 4 Aug 2026. Every other value is the name the allocator already produced, so pinning renamed nobody: checked over all 320 species, the only two that moved are those two. Collections he has not deployed are deliberately NOT pinned — "all the ones not yet deployed i will vet anyway and change as needed then".
